description: Line, area, bar, pie, radial and radar charts drawn with SVG, with touch tooltips and legends.
overview:
Charts are composed declaratively: a chart root such as `LineChart`, `AreaChart`, `BarChart`, `ComposedChart`, `PieChart`, `RadialBarChart` or `RadarChart` goes inside a `ChartContainer`, and series and axes such as `Line`, `Area`, `Bar`, `XAxis`, `YAxis` and `CartesianGrid` are added as children. These child components render nothing themselves; the root reads them and draws everything with `react-native-svg`.

Charts animate in when they first render: bars grow from the baseline, lines draw along their path, areas reveal from left to right, pie and radial sectors sweep open and radar shapes grow from the center. When the data changes, shapes animate from their previous values to the new ones.

Colors are theme tokens, not hex values. A series `color` such as `blue`, `teal` or `accent` resolves to the current token color, so charts follow light and dark mode automatically.
usage:
Describe each series in a `ChartConfig` object with a `label`, a token `color` and an optional `icon`, and pass it to `ChartContainer` as `config`. The container is full width with a 16:9 aspect ratio unless you give it an `h-`, `size-` or `aspect-` class.

Add `ChartTooltip` with `content={<ChartTooltipContent />}` to make the chart respond to touch: touching or dragging selects the nearest data point, draws a cursor and shows the tooltip, with a selection haptic. `ChartTooltipContent` supports `indicator` (`dot`, `line` or `dashed`), `hideLabel`, `hideIndicator`, `labelFormatter`, `formatter` and `nameKey`. Use `defaultIndex` on `ChartTooltip` to start with a point selected, or `onActiveIndexChange` on the chart to react to selection.

`Line`, `Area`, `Bar`, `Pie`, `RadialBar` and `Radar` take `isAnimationActive`, `animationDuration` and `animationEasing`. Bars default to 400 ms and curves, sectors and radar shapes to 1500 ms, with `ease` easing. Set `isAnimationActive={false}` to draw a series in its final state, for example when its data changes on every interaction.

Add `ChartLegend` with `content={<ChartLegendContent />}` for a legend in config order. `useChart()` returns the config inside a container, and `ChartPalette` resolves token colors for custom drawing.

examples.TooltipNoIndicator: Tooltip with only names and values.
examples.TooltipNoLabel: Tooltip with the category label hidden.
examples.TooltipLabelFormatter: A formatted date as the tooltip label.
examples.TooltipIcons: Config icons in place of color indicators.
examples.TooltipCustom: A fully custom tooltip rendered from a function.
examples.TooltipInteractive: Settings that change the tooltip on a stacked bar chart with a legend.

parts.ChartContainer: Sizes the chart and provides the config.
parts.AreaChart: Cartesian chart for `Area` series, with optional stacking.
parts.BarChart: Cartesian chart for `Bar` series, vertical or horizontal.
parts.ComposedChart: Cartesian chart that mixes lines, areas and bars.
parts.PieChart: Pie and donut charts built from `Pie`.
parts.CartesianGrid: Grid lines behind a cartesian chart.
parts.ReferenceLine: Horizontal line at a fixed value.
parts.Cell: Per-item color for bars, sectors and radial bars.
parts.PolarAngleAxis: Angle axis for radar and radial charts.
parts.ChartTooltip: Enables touch selection and the tooltip.
parts.ChartLegend: Adds a legend below the chart.
parts.ChartLegendContent: Default legend with swatches or icons.
parts.ChartPalette: Resolves token colors to concrete values.

ChartContainer.config: Series labels, token colors and icons keyed by data key.
ChartContainer.accessibilityLabel: Overrides the series names in the chart's accessibility label.
ChartContainer.className: Classes for the container; `h-`, `size-` or `aspect-` replaces the default 16:9 ratio.

LineChart.margin: Space around the plot as `top`, `right`, `bottom` and `left`.
LineChart.onActiveIndexChange: Called with the selected data index, or `null`.

AreaChart.margin: Space around the plot as `top`, `right`, `bottom` and `left`.
AreaChart.onActiveIndexChange: Called with the selected data index, or `null`.

BarChart.margin: Space around the plot as `top`, `right`, `bottom` and `left`.
BarChart.onActiveIndexChange: Called with the selected data index, or `null`.
BarChart.layout: `horizontal` for vertical bars or `vertical` for horizontal bars.
BarChart.barGap: Gap between bars in a category. Defaults to `4`.
BarChart.barCategoryGap: Gap around each category, as a number or percentage. Defaults to `10%`.

ComposedChart.margin: Space around the plot as `top`, `right`, `bottom` and `left`.
ComposedChart.onActiveIndexChange: Called with the selected data index, or `null`.

PieChart.margin: Space around the plot as `top`, `right`, `bottom` and `left`.
PieChart.onActiveIndexChange: Called with the selected data index, or `null`.

RadialBarChart.margin: Space around the plot as `top`, `right`, `bottom` and `left`.
RadialBarChart.onActiveIndexChange: Called with the selected data index, or `null`.
RadialBarChart.innerRadius: Inner radius as a number or percentage.
RadialBarChart.outerRadius: Outer radius as a number or percentage.
RadialBarChart.endAngle: End angle in degrees. Defaults to `360`.
RadialBarChart.cx: Horizontal center as a number or percentage.
RadialBarChart.cy: Vertical center as a number or percentage.

RadarChart.margin: Space around the plot as `top`, `right`, `bottom` and `left`.
RadarChart.onActiveIndexChange: Called with the selected data index, or `null`.
RadarChart.outerRadius: Outer radius as a number or percentage.
RadarChart.cy: Vertical center as a number or percentage.

CartesianGrid.vertical: Draws vertical grid lines. Set `false` to hide them.
CartesianGrid.strokeDasharray: Dash pattern for the grid lines.

XAxis.dataKey: Data key for the category values.
XAxis.interval: Number of ticks skipped between shown ticks; `0` shows every tick. Without it, ticks are thinned to fit.
XAxis.minTickGap: Minimum space between ticks. Defaults to `5`.
XAxis.tickMargin: Space between ticks and their labels.

YAxis.dataKey: Data key for the category values in a vertical layout.
YAxis.width: Axis width, or `auto` to fit the labels. Defaults to `60`.
YAxis.tickMargin: Space between ticks and their labels.

Line.dot: Point dots, a dot spec, a function per point, or `false`.
Line.activeDot: Dot at the selected point, or `false`.
Line.isAnimationActive: Animates the series in and on data changes. Defaults to `true`.

Area.stackId: Stacks areas that share an id.
Area.dot: Point dots, a dot spec, a function per point, or `false`.
Area.activeDot: Dot at the selected point, or `false`.
Area.isAnimationActive: Animates the series in and on data changes. Defaults to `true`.

Bar.radius: Corner radius, or one per corner.
Bar.stackId: Stacks bars that share an id.
Bar.background: Track behind each bar with `fill`, `fillOpacity` and `radius`.
Bar.isAnimationActive: Animates the series in and on data changes. Defaults to `true`.

ReferenceLine.y: Value where the line is drawn.
ReferenceLine.label: Text shown with the line.

LabelList.dataKey: Data key of the label values. Defaults to the series key.
LabelList.offset: Distance from the shape. Defaults to `5`.
LabelList.formatter: Formats each label; return `undefined` to skip it.

Pie.cx: Horizontal center as a number or percentage.
Pie.cy: Vertical center as a number or percentage.
Pie.innerRadius: Inner radius; above zero makes a donut.
Pie.outerRadius: Outer radius as a number or percentage.
Pie.stroke: Token color for sector outlines, or `none`.
Pie.label: Returns the label text for each sector.
Pie.labelLine: Draws lines to the labels, with an optional `stroke`.
Pie.shape: Adjusts each sector, or splits it into several.
Pie.isAnimationActive: Animates the series in and on data changes. Defaults to `true`.

RadialBar.stackId: Stacks bars that share an id.
RadialBar.background: Track behind each bar with `fill` and `fillOpacity`.
RadialBar.isAnimationActive: Animates the series in and on data changes. Defaults to `true`.

PolarAngleAxis.dataKey: Data key of the angle labels.
PolarAngleAxis.domain: Value range mapped to the full angle.
PolarAngleAxis.tickClassName: Returns classes for each tick label.

PolarRadiusAxis.angle: Angle of the axis in degrees. Defaults to `0`.
PolarRadiusAxis.tick: Set `false` to hide the tick labels.

PolarGrid.stroke: Token color for the grid lines.
PolarGrid.fill: Token color for the grid fill.

Radar.isAnimationActive: Animates the series in and on data changes. Defaults to `true`.

ChartTooltip.content: Tooltip element, or a function of the tooltip state.
ChartTooltip.cursor: Shows a cursor at the selection, or sets its stroke.
ChartTooltip.defaultIndex: Data index selected on first render.

ChartTooltipContent.nameKey: Data key used to look up series names in the config.

ChartLegendContent.nameKey: Data key used to look up legend names in the config.

ChartPalette.children: Function that receives the resolved colors.

accessibility:
- The chart is one accessible element labelled with its series names and data range; pass `accessibilityLabel` to `ChartContainer` to override the names.
- With a tooltip it has the `adjustable` role: VoiceOver and TalkBack swipe actions step through data points, and the selected values are announced as the value text.
- Without a tooltip it has the `image` role.
- With Reduce Motion on, charts skip the enter and update animations and draw in their final state.
notes:
- Series colors accept named tokens such as `blue`, `green`, `teal`, `accent`, `success`, `danger` and `label`; grid and cursor lines use `separator`.
- Value labels from `LabelList` and pie `label` appear once a series finishes animating.
- Light and dark follow the system appearance.
